notes.title: Content Update #1
notes.notes:
Update and enjoy the first content update for 'Lizard Quest!'. 

[h2]New Island[/h2]
Explore a brand new island with new puzzle elements and many hats. 

[h2]New Platforming[/h2]
Buy the new mag boots which allow you to traverse your way to other areas of the Lizard Quest world, including the new island. 

[h2]More hats[/h2]
Discover 7 new hats scattered around the world.

[h2]Slot machines[/h2]
Laslty, try your luck on the new slot machines and enjoy the rewards!
